faq.q: Does an SBA loan balance prove this house is collateral?
faq.a: Do not assume that from a balance alone. Ask the servicing office and title professionals to identify the actual loan, recorded instruments and property involved.

faq.q: Is a collateral release the same as paying off the whole loan?
faq.a: No. A request to release specified collateral and a full loan payoff answer different questions. Obtain the applicable written requirements and have the closing team reconcile them.

faq.q: Does a cash purchase automatically remove an SBA lien?
faq.a: No. A buyer's funding method does not supply servicing approval, determine the release terms or establish what money remains for the seller.

faq.q: Can I promise a closing date while a release request is pending?
faq.a: Treat the unresolved approval and document steps as dependencies. Ask the servicing office and closing team what remains outstanding before making a firm promise.
